slides.title: Research teams lose the thread between interviews
slides.purpose: Research teams lose the thread between interviews

runs.text: A fictional product team stores interview notes in documents, decisions in chat, and research plans in spreadsheets. Insights become difficult to trace when the project changes hands.

slides.notes: Entirely synthetic business example. This deck contains no real customer results, market estimates or fundraising claims.

slides.title: The problem is continuity, not another note-taking tool
slides.purpose: The problem is continuity, not another note-taking tool

blocks.title: Fragmented evidence
blocks.body: An insight has no durable link to the interview excerpt that supports it.

blocks.title: Unclear decisions
blocks.body: The team cannot easily tell which open questions changed the product direction.

blocks.title: Expensive handoffs
blocks.body: The next researcher starts by reconstructing the previous project.

slides.title: Evidence to gather before expanding the pilot
slides.purpose: Evidence to gather before expanding the pilot

blocks.title: Interview researchers
blocks.body: Observe how participants locate an excerpt and reconstruct a decision. Treat findings as unresolved until the author reviews them.

blocks.title: Test the handoff
blocks.body: Ask a second researcher to continue a synthetic project without a verbal briefing.

slides.title: Two options trade speed against traceability
slides.purpose: Two options trade speed against traceability

blocks.title: Improve existing documents
blocks.body: Add templates and naming conventions. Faster to start, with continued manual linking.

blocks.title: Build a focused research workspace
blocks.body: Link excerpts, questions and decisions locally. More initial engineering, with a narrower handoff workflow.

runs.text: The proposed workspace keeps source excerpts next to the decisions they inform. Pilot one handoff workflow before investing in integrations or automated analysis.

slides.title: The main risk is adding work for researchers
slides.purpose: The main risk is adding work for researchers

runs.text: Keep capture lightweight. Do not make authors maintain a second copy of their notes. Review the time spent linking evidence alongside any improvement in handoff clarity.

slides.title: Next action: approve the pilot and review the evidence
slides.purpose: Next action: approve the pilot and review the evidence

blocks.title: Owner
blocks.body: Maya, product lead, owns recruitment and the pilot scope.

blocks.title: Review point
blocks.body: At the end of six weeks, inspect the interview notes and decide whether to continue, revise or stop.
